name: Special City Council Meeting - 3:30 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Special City Council Meeting - 3:30 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, MAY 6, 2020 -
03:30 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
Pursuant to the State of California Executive Order n-29-20 and the amended County Health Order dated March 18, 2020 (limiting gatherings to no more than 10 people), members of the public will only be allowed to participate in meetings electronically.
Meeting can be accessed as follows:
• Channel 19 on Cox Communications
• Channel 24 on Time Warner Cable
• Channel 99 on AT&T U-Verse
• City's live webcast: https://encinitasca.gov/Government/Agendas-Webcasts
PUBLIC COMMENTS
Public comments regarding this agenda must be submitted via email to clerk@encinitasca.gov
Comments regarding this agenda received by 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting will be provided to the City Council and read into the record at the meeting for up to three minutes or in accordance with the time period established by the Mayor/Chair.
Comments regarding this agenda received after 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting will be provided to the City Council and made a part of the meeting record.
CALL TO ORDER/ROLL CALL
AGENDA ITEMS
1.
Receive oral report regarding the City's COVID-19 response and actions including a status of compliance, closures, beaches, and related costs.
1) Receive the oral report and discuss; and 2) Provide direction to staff related to COVID-19.
2020-05-06 Special Meeting Item #1 - COVID-19 Report Outline
2.
COVID-19 response for emergency non-congregate sheltering - Temporary Emergency Motel Voucher Program. Contact Person: Principal Planner Gates
1) Consider approval of the Memorandum of Agreement (MOA) between the City and the County to provide up to 22 hotel rooms for "high-risk" individuals that are experiencing homelessness during the COVID-19 pandemic for a period up to July 31, 2020, or until the Governor or County Order to shelter in place is lifted; or consider approval of extension of the City's existing hotel voucher program for an additional four weeks to end June 12, 2020; and
2) If County MOA is approved, consider approval of the amendment to the existing Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with the Community Resource Center to providing case management services for the "high-risk" individuals utilizing the temporary lodging and other program management at a cost not to exceed $12,000 (10% of lodging costs for administrative fee) for a period from May 15 through July 31, 2020, or until the Governor or County Order to shelter in place is lifted; or if City continues its existing hotel voucher program for an additional four weeks to end June 12, 2020, authorize the modification of the MOU not to exceed amount of $47,000.

ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
